# Security Policy

NHSMM is pre-1.0 research software. Security maintenance follows the current `develop` line; older snapshots and releases do not have a maintained backport policy.

## Supported line

| Code line | Security maintenance |
| --- | --- |
| `develop` | current fixes land here |
| older snapshots / releases | no guaranteed backports |

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report security-sensitive issues privately through GitHub Security Advisories for `awa-si/nhsmm` when available. Do not open a public issue for an unpatched vulnerability.

Include:

- affected version or commit;
- minimal reproduction or triggering conditions;
- expected impact;
- relevant environment details;
- known mitigation, if any.

Reports are triaged on a best-effort basis; no response-time SLA is implied.
